kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنتفع (form VIII)
# أَنْتَفِعُ (ʔantafiʕu) /ʔan.ta.fi.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَفَعَ (intafaʕa)
# أَنْتَفِعَ (ʔantafiʕa) /ʔan.ta.fi.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَفَعَ (intafaʕa)
# أَنْتَفِعْ (ʔantafiʕ) /ʔan.ta.fiʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْتَفَعَ (intafaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
